archetype: Trust Ledger ice POS for Indian retail

headings.instruction: Inter for English. Hind fallback for Devanagari. Money uses font-mono tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono).

body.instruction: Inter for UI. JetBrains Mono for rupee amounts, quantities, and kbd.

primary.usage: Headings and navy chrome. Tailwind: ink / surface

accent_money.usage: Primary CTA, FAB, kamai. Tailwind: mint / mint-soft / mint-dark

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Follow .stitch/DESIGN.md. Solid navy chrome (ds-glass-dark). Solid ds-panel for tables (12px). Controls 8px radius. Primary CTAs bg-mint #2563EB. No voice. Canvas is ds-mesh #EAF2FF.

desktop_ledger.structure: Navy sidebar 260px + ice mesh canvas. Sticky ice top bar.

mobile_first_pos.structure: Fixed Top Header + Scrollable Main + Fixed Bottom Navigation. New Bill FAB is blue (mint token).

grids.dashboard: Single KPI ledger strip (2x2 mobile, 4-col desktop). Values in font-mono.
grids.split_payment: 2-column grid for Cash vs Online vs Udhari.

layouts.spacing: Dense on tables, comfortable on KPI cards (p-4).

new_bill_fab.style: h-16 w-16 rounded-full bg-mint text-white ring-4 ring-mint/20

draft_confirmation_card.style: border-2 border-amber-500 bg-amber-50 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-md
draft_confirmation_card.content: Must clearly show 'Old Value' with strikethrough -> 'New Value' in bold green. Two distinct CTA buttons: 'Confirm (Tick)' and 'Cancel (Cross)'.

pdf_preview_modal.style: max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-canvas p-2 md:p-4 rounded-xl
pdf_preview_modal.content: A4 preview of the jsPDF output centered like paper.

badges.low_stock: bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-control text-xs font-bold border border-rose-200
badges.godown: bg-mint-soft text-mint-dark px-2 py-1 rounded-control text-xs font-bold
badges.showroom: bg-slate-100 text-ink px-2 py-1 rounded-control text-xs font-bold

components.instructions: Use Shadcn with density overrides. Card padding p-4. Primary button is mint (Trust Ledger #2563EB). Cards 12px, controls 8px.

motion.interactions: All buttons must have active:scale-95 and transition-transform. Do NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.voice_active: Removed. App is not a voice assistant.
motion.draft_appearance: Draft cards slide up from the bottom.

visual_enhancers.borders: Hairline #C7DDFF on solid panels. Navy chrome uses white/8 edge.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Headers use translucent ice. Sidebar is solid navy. Never frost tables or cart rows. prefers-reduced-transparency: solid fill.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1. Ink/navy buttons use white text.
accessibility.bilingual: Keep UI text concise. Devanagari needs leading-relaxed in lists.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, forms, and draft cards.

media.icons: lucide-react. Primary actions medium weight, secondary thin.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts for data apps. Left-align text, right-align currency/numbers.
Primary actions are Trust Ledger blue (mint token #2563EB). Canvas is ice #EAF2FF. Sidebar is navy #1B365D.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Every draft MUST pause the app flow and require a manual click to confirm.
Do not replace pages with Stitch HTML. Map DESIGN.md tokens into existing React.
